player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id}. Ikaw ya nagpapatanan ed Guess The Number.
Nagamit ka ya manguilib so numero ed siam ya {min_number} tan {max_number} diad {max_turns} turn.
No enter mo so manguilib mo, say laro ya agiyapapagel so hints a kas a 'masanto' o 'masmellom'.
Kaiba mo ya agpapagel so respons mo diad any manner. Say numero ya nakapapetec ed squar brackets so isasa ya ikalimo a bilang say manguilib mo. Agyaman, [5].
No nagpapatanan ka, say historia na manguilib mo ya agiyapapagmaliw ed siabay. Gamiten mo so impormasyon a yan para kompletan so laro bago ka mapukaw na manguilib.
Enter mo so manguilib mo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mali a pormat na gawa. Say player {player_id} agnanao'y umsagot na may balido ya '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mali'y kilos. Managpalya {player_id} nagues ed numero ya arap ed range ya espesipikado.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Aliwan dugan galaw. Say manlalaban {player_id} so akabat la ed numero.

game_message.target_higher: Mas atagey so target na bilang.
game_message.target_lower: Mas abeba so target a bilang.

outcome.win: Komendasyon! Duga so inisip yon bilang.
outcome.turn_limit: Naabotan na so limita na turn. Guess: {guess}, Target: {target}
